evidence.name: Screen field: Width of the field icon
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Width of the field icon" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Width of the field icon
sections.description: Sets how wide the icon beside the input is (0-500px). Keep it small, around 20-24px, so it fits neatly next to the text, and usually match it to the icon height for a clean square glyph. Oversized icons crowd the field and make the input look heavier than it needs to.
